insert_vectors_to_collection: insert vectors into a Pinecone collection with metadata and collection prefix filtering
upsert_vectors_to_collection: upsert vectors into a Pinecone collection, creating or updating existing entries in parallel batches
search_similar_vectors: search for similar vectors in a Pinecone collection using cosine similarity or other metrics
delete_collection_from_pinecone: delete a Pinecone collection by removing all vectors matching its prefixed collection name
reset_pinecone_index: reset the Pinecone index by deleting all vectors across all collections
